P.name: Rebirth
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Anivia''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 6 seconds and restores all of her {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
P.description2: While under resurrection, '''Anivia''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains {{pp|-40 to 20 for 5|1;5;8;12;15|changedisplay=true}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
P.description3: If '''Anivia''' remains alive by the end of the duration, she is revived with her {{as|'''current''' health}}.

Q.name: Flash Frost
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' launches a chunk of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|20;20 to 40 for 3|0 to 3|type = [[File:Glacial Storm.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Glacial Storm's'' Rank|formula = 20% + (10% * (''Glacial Storm's'' rank - 1))}} for 3 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Flash Frost'' can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Anivia''' shatters the ice, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for a duration, as well as refreshing the {{tip|slow}}.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|50+60 to 130+200}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45+25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}

W.name: Crystallize
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' summons a wall of ice at the target location perpendicular to her facing, {{tip|airborne|knocking}} all units away from it, though not through terrain. The wall lingers as impassable terrain for 5 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|{{tt|Width|Pathfinding}}|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|600 to 1000}} units}}
{{st|Number of ice segments|{{ap|4 to 8}} chunks of ice|Distance between outermost segments|{{ap|400 to 800}} units|Distance between individual segments|{{ap|133.33|125|120|116.67|114.29}} units}}

E.name: Frostbite
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemies hit by ''{{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' or a fully formed ''{{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}}'' become ''Iced'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} if they were ''Iced''.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Enhanced Damage|{{ap|55*2 to 155*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Glacial Storm
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Anivia''' calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while they remain inside.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|6.25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
R.description3: The blizzard increases in size over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. At maximum size, ''Glacial Storm'' is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%, which also instead lasts {{fd|1.5}} seconds and refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Empowered Damage per Tick|{{ap|15*3 to 30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6.25*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Empowered Slow|{{ap|20*1.5 to 40*1.5}}%}}
R.description4: Toggling ''Glacial Storm'' off triggers a final tick of damage and incurs its full cooldown. ''Glacial Storm'' is toggled off automatically if '''Anivia''' moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
